technique_name: Reverse engineer a content marketing strategy for a new start-up.
description: An effective content marketing strategy for the new start-up should involve posting new, high-quality content regularly on a blog or website. The content should center around Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning technology and should educate the reader on upcoming trends and strategies. Additionally, the content should also feature informative “how-to” articles and informational videos on the technology. Social media engagement should also be included, with content posted on platfor
example: The start-up specializes in AI and machine learning technology.
